plausibility_notes: Every attendee delivers a remarkably similar confession: I did wrong, Grant exploited it, and I now self-critique. Prepared dialogue makes this stylistic sameness particularly audible.
Scandal confessions explain documents but do not logically clear anyone of murder.
Artie’s new job softens but does not erase resentment over donor claiming credit for dismissal.
